architecture: Boltz-2 -- AlphaFold3-class biomolecular structure and binding-affinity predictor, PyTorch Lightning checkpoints
execution_class: scientific inference over a pairformer trunk; NOT autoregressive, no tokenizer, no KV cache
why_it_was_open: ships boltz2_aff.ckpt and boltz2_conf.ckpt with NO config.json at all; the census reader needed metadata that was never written
structure: two separate models (confidence 2.13 GiB, affinity 1.92 GiB); pairformer blocks repeat 64x with 128 proj_z tensors; Lightning optimizer_states and an EMA copy present in the archive
gravity_note: SHIPPED ENTIRELY IN FP32. Complete EBPW 32.031 across 1.085B matrix params. Every other specimen in the lake is bf16 or lower. A bf16 cast is a 2x file win before any Gravity work begins, and the interesting question is not whether it compresses but why nobody has taken the free half.
capability_note: domain-specific; no language capability, so the campaign's verifier (perplexity/top-1/KL over text) does not apply and a structural-accuracy verifier would have to be built first
disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN -- fp32 headroom is a real and cheap finding; deep Gravity work is DEFERRED because the verifier does not exist and building one is a separate campaign
reopen: if a structure-prediction verifier is built, this is the lake's only fp32 body and therefore its cleanest headroom test
accounting_verified: tensor bytes equal on-disk bytes to two decimals after two producer defects were fixed: a DeepSpeed container that yielded zero tensors silently, and logical bytes that double-counted a storage-aliased EMA copy by 48%.
